title: The Dim Hand Primer
summary: A first primer on wrapping the hand and forearm in thin darkness so that blows and guards are hard to read by sight.

title: A Handbook of Quiet Dark
summary: A handbook on keeping dark qi still and silent so that a student's steps and breath leave no sound in the shade.

title: The Shade Keeper's Workbook
summary: A workbook on gathering a small store of shade round the body and drawing on it for guards and short steps.

title: Primer of the Lightless Step
summary: A primer on moving through dim places by feel and by dark qi so that a student never needs a lamp to keep footing.

title: The Umbra Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of plain exercises that teach the student to throw out darkness in small shapes and pull it back again.

title: A Plain Guide to Dimming
summary: A plain guide to lowering the light round a target or round oneself by a fraction so that eyes work harder and fail sooner.

title: The Pall and Cloak Handbook
summary: A handbook on spreading a pall of dark qi and wearing it as a cloak that blurs the outline of the wearer.

title: Workbook of the Hollow Dark
summary: A workbook on the empty kind of darkness that takes in light and sound and leaves the student a dark space to act from.
